required: Aggregate output must use canvas-style sections and list invariants, policies, commands, events, and human confirmations.
Separate evidence, inference, recommendation, and human confirmation when relevant.
Include tests or validation when the design affects implementation.
reject: Generic design advice with no project evidence.
Unstated adoption of DDD, Clean Architecture, CQRS, Event Sourcing, or microservices.
Missing human confirmation items for business or organizational decisions.
